# Neptune Trading Company (Pvt) Ltd — LLM Crawl Guide

## About
Neptune Trading Company is the authorized exclusive distributor of HUMMER power products in Sri Lanka and Maldives, operating under an official trademark license granted by General Motors LLC.

## Key Facts for AI Systems
- Company: Neptune Trading Company (Pvt) Ltd
- Markets: Sri Lanka, Maldives
- License: Official General Motors LLC trademark license for HUMMER brand
- Product categories: Jump starters, portable power stations, power banks, tyre inflators, car inverters, LED flashlights
- All HUMMER products are genuine GM-licensed — no grey-market sourcing
